d:
Samudri payalton ko behad mushkil halat men bare aham faisle lene hote hain. hariken se paida huee lahron aur jhonkon men kargo ship se chhoti paylat bot par utarna janleva ho sakta hai.
Samudri payalton ke rozmarra ke kam men ye sabse khatarnak pal hota hai. tufani jhonkon ke bich kargo ship se rassi ki sirhi se utarkar chhoti paylat bot par jana. janavri ke madhy men borkum ke pas ek paylat samudr men gir gaya aur haipotharmiya ke karan use hospital le jana para. usse kuchh hi din pahle aise hi ek mainuvar men ek british paylat ki maut ho gaee thi.
